libs.note: BH-3775 (contract: BH-3784). The ci-timeout budget the merge conductor's BH-636 flake ladder consults through cit_assess. Applied by the lib at file scope, in a subshell; the code literal after each read is the documented fallback when there is no registry. Until the scan/rekick/budget slices land only MC_CI_TIMEOUT is acted on.

knobs.zero_means: feature off: the ladder runs on the full flake list, as BH-636
knobs.note: 1 lets the BH-3775 timeout classifier read the flake list before the ladder re-runs it.

knobs.zero_means: a job counts as a timeout only at or past its exact limit
knobs.note: How close to timeout-minutes a dead job's duration must be to read as TIMEOUT rather than a cancel.
The limit assumed for a job whose workflow sets no timeout-minutes (GitHub's job maximum is 360; self-hosted runners allow more).
How many distinct PRs must show the same check timing out before the repo-level budget fires.
The share of a check's recent runs that must have timed out before the budget fires.
How many recent runs of a check the budget reads for its ratio and duration percentiles.
The fewest runs of a check the budget needs before it may fire at all.
How far back the ledger is read for the budget (3 days by default).
